M2.reason: Amendment 4 (2026-11-07): withdrawn. No endpoint could both vary with density and fail here. The precision difference in differences at cap 20 is zero or negative on all eight designed seeds, because the precision gap is set by the eight crowded sources and does not vary with density. The coverage gap varies only through |W|: at cap 20 the dense-end gap is bounded by 20/192, so with M1's 0.15 bar the difference in differences is at least 0.0625 on every integer-coverage seed and the old 0.05 bar could not fail while M1 passed. M1 is the sole criterion; the coverage and precision gaps by density are reported as a characterization and are not scored.
